course_listing_description.pagination: The course listing is not paginated; it uses a single scrollable list of courses (infinite scroll approach).
course_listing_description.filters: The page has filter options including: Discipline (e.g., Aerospace Engineering, Biotechnology), Institute (e.g., IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi), and Course Type (Video, Web).
course_listing_description.search: There are two search boxes: one for searching courses by name and one for searching by instructor name.
